title: fix(lint)!: publish refuses a text-vs-number comparison in a validation rule (or another fail-closed predicate) instead of warning, then refusing every write
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7J3TmFTYMYQrfpye6GQNg9)_

Fixes #29904

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the author-time gate (`os build`, `os validate`, the object save door and the package publish) refuses a `type-mismatch` it used to pass with a warning, at the predicate sites that fail closed. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` (the build-time validation table's type-soundness row said `warning` for every site) and the MCP skill text in `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`; `skills/**` teaches no text-vs-number comparison and no type-soundness severity (grep for the verdict words and `record.X > N` on text fields: 0 hits), so no skill or eval moves.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：校验规则（以及 requiredWhen / readonlyWhen、选项 visibleWhen、hook 条件）里"文本字段和数字比大小"（如 `record.name > 5`）现在发布时直接拒绝（error），公式字段仍只给 warning。
- 为什么改：这些位置求值失败会拒绝写入；以前发布只提示"会得到 null"，发布成功后该对象的每次新建和更新都被拒，一个笔误就让整张表录不进数据。
- 风险与回滚：收窄发布门，已存在的此类规则下次发布会被拒（它们本来就让写入全部失败）；回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/formula/src/validate.ts`（fail-closed 分支与文案）、`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`（`FAIL_CLOSED` 站点表及各调用点）、`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`（validation 站点）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/publish-type-mismatch-fail-closed.test.ts`，预期 3 条全过：校验规则被拒、公式仍发布带 warning、可空孪生照旧被拒。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/formula`.** `ExprSchemaHint` gains `faultOutcome?: 'fail-closed'`. The validator cannot tell a validation rule's `predicate` from a flow condition's, so the caller that knows the site declares it. With it, `type-mismatch` is graded an **error** whose message says what really happens (the write, or the operation a hook guards, is refused) and how to compare like with like; the refusal's `params` carry `outcome: 'fail-closed'`. Without it, the warning and its "evaluates to null" text are unchanged.
- **`@objectstack/lint`.** One constant, `FAIL_CLOSED`, with the site ledger in its docblock, passed by `check()` at exactly the fail-closed sites: validation rule `condition` / `when` and nested `then` / `otherwise` rules, field `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen`, option `visibleWhen`, hook `condition`. These are the sites where the nullable-comparison twin is already an error with the `'fail-closed'` outcome (plus `readonlyWhen` and option `visibleWhen`, see below).
- **`@objectstack/mcp`.** `validate_expression` with `site: 'validation'` passes the same outcome, so the tool an agent self-checks with answers what publish will. Its description and the served skill text say so.
- **`@objectstack/spec`.** Upgrade guide entry `validation-type-mismatch-refused` (semantic: no mechanical rewrite). ADR-0087 disposition `registered validation-type-mismatch-refused`.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`: the type-soundness row's severity and fix.

### Which roles fail closed (measured by reading each evaluator)

| site | runtime on a fault | this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| validation rule `condition` / `when`, nested rules | `rule-validator.ts` `checkPredicate` / `checkConditional`: "write rejected" (#4649) | error |
| field `requiredWhen` | `rule-validator.ts`: refuses the write (ADR-0137 D2) | error |
| field `readonlyWhen` | `isReadonlyWhenLocked`: throws `ValidationError` on every fault but the unbound-root carve-out (ADR-0137 D2) | error |
| option `visibleWhen` | `evaluateOptionVisibility`: refuses a write that picks the option (ADR-0137 D2, #22402) | error |
| hook `condition` | `hook-wrappers.ts`: aborts the operation (#4775) | error |
| formula field `expression` | reads null | warning (text true) |
| flow start / edge / `decision` condition | the run fails; the write that fired it lands (`run-fails`) | warning, left out: not a write gate. Open question in the report |
| field `visibleWhen` / `settledWhen`, `conditionalFormatting`, field group `visibleWhen`, action `visible` / `disabled` / `pressed`, app landing `visible` | renderer shows, hides or styles; never refuses a write | warning |
| sharing rule `condition`; RLS / permission predicates | compiled to a query filter (`compileCelToFilter` / `isSupportedRlsExpression`), not CEL per row | not judged by this verdict |

The evaluator's fail-closed behaviour is untouched.

**The conversion the message names, measured on the evaluator** (`ExpressionEngine.evaluate`, values `"abc"` / `"7"` / null): `record.name > 5` → FAULT / true / FAULT; `size(record.name) > 5` → false / false / FAULT; `double(record.name) > 5` → FAULT / true / FAULT (validates clean, faults on non-numeric text, so the message says so); `int(...)` same as `double`.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`: the old pin "warns on a validation predicate ordering a text field against a number" is the behaviour this card retires; it is replaced by five pins: the validation `condition` refusal (path `objects[0].validations[0].condition`, message), the formula warning, one refusal per other fail-closed site (`when`, nested `then`, `requiredWhen`, `readonlyWhen` on a boolean, option `visibleWhen`, hook `condition`), the warning kept on field `visibleWhen` and action `visible`, and the nullable twin unchanged.
- `packages/formula/src/validate.test.ts`: `faultOutcome` → error with `code`/`params`, boolean arm, and the two conversions validate clean.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-validate-expression.test.ts`: `site: 'validation'` → error.
- `packages/objectql/src/publish-type-mismatch-fail-closed.test.ts` (new): the real protocol `saveMetaItem` (draft) + `publishPackageDrafts` over a real ObjectQL: refused with `expression-invalid` / `error` at `…validations[0].condition`; formula publishes with the warning advisory; the nullable twin still refused.

```

lint test        Test Files 192 passed (192)  Tests 7949 passed (7949)
mcp test         Test Files 55 passed (55)    Tests 660 passed (660)

```

<details><summary>Ablation (old severity put back in the fail-closed branch, formula rebuilt, marker proven in dist)</summary>

Mutation: `severity: 'error'` → `severity: ['warning', 'ablated-29904'][0] as 'warning'` in the fail-closed arm; `ablation-replace` anchor 1 → 0, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`.

```
lint     × refuses a validation predicate ordering a required text field against a number (#29904)
           AssertionError: expected { …(5) } to match object { severity: 'error', …(1) }
         × refuses the type mismatch at every other fail-closed site (#29904)
         Tests 2 failed | 3 passed
objectql × refuses `record.name > 5` on a required text field in validations[].condition
           AssertionError: expected 'published' to be 'refused'
formula  × errors on the same comparison where the caller declares the site fail-closed (#29904)
mcp      × errors on a text field ordered against a number at a validation site (#29904)
```
The nullable-twin pins stayed green under the mutation (they are the control). Restore: blob back to HEAD `6fcce907`, `git diff HEAD` empty, formula rebuilt, preflight `--absent` clean on all 6 built files; lint 5/5 and objectql 3/3 green again.
</details>

<details><summary>Real boot (showcase `pnpm dev -- --fresh`, full build at d5b798c0f, as admin, writable package com.qa.tmm)</summary>

```
[1] PUT /api/v1/meta/object/tmm_lead?mode=draft  (required text `name`, rule `record.name > 5`) → 200
    POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.tmm/publish-drafts → 200 outcome=refused
      rule=expression-invalid severity=error path=objects.tmm_lead.validations[0].condition
      message: type mismatch `string > int` — `record.name` holds text but is used with `>` against a number.
      CEL has no such operation, so wherever the value is not numeric text (an empty value included) the
      expression faults, and here an expression that cannot be evaluated fails closed: the write (or the
      operation a hook guards) is refused, not skipped. Compare like with like: … `size(record.name)` for its
      length, `double(record.name)` for its value (which itself faults on text that is not a number).
[1b] same rule as `size(record.name) > 5` → publish 200 outcome=published
    POST /api/v1/data/tmm_lead {"name":"abc"}     → 201
    POST /api/v1/data/tmm_lead {"name":"abcdefg"} → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED rule_violation "bad"   (the rule now judges)
[2] formula `big = record.name > 5` → publish 200 published, advisory expression-invalid severity=warning "… silently evaluates to null …"
[4] nullable twin `record.qty > 1000` → publish 200 outcome=refused, expression-invalid error "… declares as nullable …" (unchanged)
```
Before (card, main `589049b0`): the same `[1]` published with a `warning`, and every `POST /data` answered 400 "could not be evaluated … write rejected". The draft save answers 200 for both this rule and the twin, as before (the save door keeps #4463 D1).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Validation rules of `severity: 'warning'` / `'info'`.** The runtime logs an unevaluable advisory rule instead of refusing; the gate refuses the comparison on every validation rule regardless, exactly as the nullable twin does. Kept for parity with the twin; the message's "refused" clause is exact for `error` rules.
- **`readonlyWhen` and option `visibleWhen`** are fail-closed sites the twin does not cover (its `readonlyWhen` exclusion is ruling #4953 clause 3, about the `has()` prescription, which this verdict does not give). Included because their evaluators refuse the write on a fault.
- **Serial check.** At 2026-11-03T11:40Z and again at 12:55Z (before opening), none of the open PRs touches `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` or `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` (per-PR file lists read).

## Verification

All at the final head **1dfad411f**.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 106 derived families, each run, all **exit 0**; `--ran` reconciliation: "106 derived, 106 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". The first round (at d5b798c0f) had one red, `check:objectql-double-limit` (the new test's copied `find` double ignored `limit`); fixed in 1dfad411f, and the whole list was run again.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0.
- Full dogfood (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, after a full `turbo run build`, 119/119 tasks): Test Files 410 passed | 3 skipped (413), Tests 3379 passed | 28 skipped (3407); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: "registered validation-type-mismatch-refused (new here)".
